Juri Is Fast. But She Is Not Always Plus.

2026年9月27日時点、Ver.2.0401.010を基準に、Juriの強さを“fast normals”ではなく“cr.MK・Drive Rush・Fuha stocksをconnectしてturnを延ばすsystem”として読む。Most raw normals are minus on block、cr.MK is a low and regular Gladius upper-body armor does not answer it、stock building takes time、M/H Tensenrin are not fully invincible against grounded strikes。Modern Marisa側がrespect / stop / punishをどこで切り替えるかへ落とす。
